topics.name: Notation and conventions
topics.centralQuestion: What symbols, number sets and conventions does the course use?

topics.name: Statements and proofs
topics.centralQuestion: How are statements built with connectives and quantifiers, and which proof techniques establish them?

topics.name: Sets
topics.centralQuestion: How are sets described, combined and proved equal by double inclusion?

topics.name: Maps
topics.centralQuestion: What are maps, and what characterises injective, surjective and bijective ones?

topics.name: Relations and induction
topics.centralQuestion: How do equivalence relations partition a set, and how does induction prove statements?

topics.name: Groups
topics.centralQuestion: Which axioms define a group, and what are subgroups and homomorphisms?

topics.name: Rings and fields
topics.centralQuestion: Which axioms define a ring and a field, and when is $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ a field?

topics.name: Complex numbers
topics.centralQuestion: How does arithmetic in $\mathbb{C}$ work, and why does every polynomial have a complex root?

topics.name: Matrices and linear systems
topics.centralQuestion: How is a linear system $Ax=b$ expressed with matrices, and what structure does it have?

topics.name: Elementary row operations and row echelon form
topics.centralQuestion: How does Gaussian elimination bring a system to (reduced) row echelon form without changing its solutions?

topics.name: Reading off the solution
topics.centralQuestion: How is the full solution set read off from the reduced row echelon form?

topics.name: Vector Spaces
topics.centralQuestion: What is a vector space, and which basic structures — subspaces, span, bases, dimension, sums — does it carry?

topics.name: Definition and examples
topics.centralQuestion: Besides $K^n$, which spaces are $K$-vector spaces?

topics.name: Subspaces
topics.centralQuestion: Which subsets of a vector space are subspaces, and how does span generate one?

topics.name: Linear independence and bases
topics.centralQuestion: When are vectors linearly independent, and how do bases and coordinates work?

topics.name: Dimension
topics.centralQuestion: Why is the size of a basis well defined, and how is dimension computed?

topics.name: Sums and direct sums
topics.centralQuestion: When is a sum of subspaces direct, and how do dimensions add up?

topics.name: Computing with subspaces of $K^n$
topics.centralQuestion: How are bases, sums and intersections of subspaces of $K^n$ computed algorithmically?

topics.name: Linear Maps and Matrices
topics.centralQuestion: How do linear maps correspond to matrices, and which invariants such as rank do they have?

topics.name: Linear maps
topics.centralQuestion: Which maps between vector spaces are linear, and how do kernel and image behave?

topics.name: The rank-nullity theorem
topics.centralQuestion: How does rank-nullity relate kernel, image and dimensions?

topics.name: The matrix of a linear map
topics.centralQuestion: How is a linear map represented by a matrix, and when is that matrix invertible?

topics.name: Change of basis
topics.centralQuestion: How do the matrices of one map change when the basis changes?

topics.name: The rank of a matrix
topics.centralQuestion: Why do row rank and column rank coincide, and how is rank computed?

topics.name: Quotient spaces
topics.centralQuestion: What is a quotient space $V/U$, and how does the homomorphism theorem apply to it?

topics.name: Elementary matrices
topics.centralQuestion: How do elementary matrices encode row and column operations and factorisations?

topics.name: The dual space
topics.centralQuestion: What is the dual space $V^*$, and how does a linear map act on it?

topics.name: Determinants
topics.centralQuestion: How is the determinant defined, and what does it tell us about invertibility and volume?

topics.name: Permutations
topics.centralQuestion: How is the sign of a permutation defined, and why is it multiplicative?

topics.name: Multilinear alternating forms and the determinant
topics.centralQuestion: Which axioms determine the determinant, and what does the Leibniz formula say?

topics.name: Properties of the determinant
topics.centralQuestion: How does the determinant behave under products, transposes, similarity and row operations?

topics.name: Laplace expansion and Cramer's rule
topics.centralQuestion: How do Laplace expansion, the adjugate and Cramer's rule compute determinants and solve systems?

topics.name: Eigenvalues and eigenvectors
topics.centralQuestion: What are eigenvalues, eigenvectors and eigenspaces, and what do they constrain?

topics.name: The characteristic polynomial
topics.centralQuestion: How does the characteristic polynomial and its multiplicities encode the eigenvalues?

topics.name: Diagonalisability
topics.centralQuestion: When is a matrix diagonalisable, and how is the diagonalisation carried out?

topics.name: An application: linear recursions
topics.centralQuestion: How does diagonalisation of a matrix solve linear recursions such as the Fibonacci numbers?

topics.name: Invariant subspaces
topics.centralQuestion: Which subspaces are invariant under an endomorphism, and how do they produce block form?
